The beam is reinforced with the tension steel of [latex]800\ \text{mm}^2[/latex] area at an effective cover of 40 mm. Consider M20 concrete and Fe415 steel. Let the stress block considered for concrete in IS 456:2000 be replaced by an equivalent rectangular stress block, with no change in: (a) the area of the stress block, (b) the design strength of concrete (at the strain of 0.0035), and (c) the location of neutral axis at flexural collapse. The ultimate moment of resistance of the beam (in kN.m) is __________________ (round off to the nearest integer).

questions.text: For a partially saturated soil deposit at a construction site, water content (w) is 15%, degree of saturation (S) is 67%, void ratio (e) is 0.6 and specific gravity of solids in the soil ([latex]G_s[/latex]) is 2.67. Consider unit weight of water as [latex]9.81\ \text{kN/m}^3[/latex]. To fully saturate [latex]5\ \text{m}^3[/latex] of this soil, the required weight of water (in kN) will be ______ (round off to the nearest integer).

questions.text: Consider flow in a long and very wide rectangular open channel. Width of the channel can be considered as infinity compared to the depth of flow.  Uniform flow depth is 1.0 m. The critical depth (in m) corresponding to the flow rate resulting from the above conditions is ______ (round off to one decimal place).

Two-legged vertical stirrups of 10 mm diameter and Fe415 steel at a spacing of 100 mm are provided as shear reinforcement. questions.text: A designer used plate load test to obtain the value of the bearing capacity factor [latex]N_\gamma[/latex]. The unit weight of the sand is [latex]16.66\ \text{kN/m}^3[/latex]. The plate is loaded to failure at a pressure of [latex]1500\ \text{kPa}[/latex]. questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.text:
A community generates 1 million litres/day (MLD) of wastewater. This wastewater is treated using an activated sludge process (ASP). The working volume of the aeration tank of the ASP is [latex]250\ \text{m}^3[/latex], and the biomass concentration in the tank is [latex]3000\ \text{mg/L}[/latex].
Analysis results showed that a biomass concentration of [latex]10\ \text{mg/L}[/latex] is present in the treated effluent from the secondary sedimentation tank of the ASP.
Sludge wastage from the system is at a rate of [latex]5000\ \text{L/day}[/latex] with a biomass concentration of [latex]10000\ \text{mg/L}[/latex].
The system is in steady-state condition. The biological sludge residence time (BSRT) of the system (in days) is ______ (round off to one decimal place).

The minimum size of particle that will be removed with 100% efficiency in the settling chamber (in [latex]\mu m[/latex]) is ______ (round off to one decimal place).

questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.text: "His life was divided between the books, his friends, and long walks. A solitary man, he worked at all hours without much method, and probably courted his fatal illness in this way. To his own name there is not much to show; but such was his liberality that he was continually helping others, and fruits of his erudition are widely scattered, and have gone to increase many a comparative stranger's reputation." (From E.V. Lucas's "A Funeral") Based only on the information provided in the above passage, which one of the following statements is true? (A) The solitary man described in the passage is dead. (B) Strangers helped create a grand reputation for the solitary man described in the passage. (C) The solitary man described in the passage found joy in scattering fruits. (D) The solitary man worked in a court where he fell ill.
